policy: Pinned exact, case-sensitive English-source candidates retain original text, resource key, paths, revision, authors and license evidence. Each candidate records translated-resource fuzzy and English-source sourceFuzzy flags from the pinned XML. Only explicitly non-fuzzy candidates may be reused; fuzzy candidates remain as provenance but are excluded from bundled/default generation and explicit refresh. Qt wins duplicate sources, then non-fuzzy Apple, then eligible Android gaps, except attributable exact-context reviewed inputs retain precedence. Community attribution does not establish language competence or application-context review. No English padding, inferred synonyms, placeholder rewrites or plural inventions.
